title: Small functions
description:
Write in `solution.c`. Put `power` and `factorial` below `choose`, and declare them with prototypes at the top so `choose` can use them:

```c
long long power(long long base, int exponent);   /* exponent >= 0 */
long long factorial(int n);                      /* 0! is 1; use recursion */
long long choose(int n, int k);                  /* ways to pick k of n: n! / (k! (n-k)!); 0 if k < 0 or k > n */
int clamp(int value, int low, int high);         /* value kept between low and high */
```

`choose` is only tested with n up to 20, so the factorials fit in a `long long`.
